audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is flat 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already carries the real chart: Zilean at Level 1, Rell from Level 3 through first item, Zilean again at 2+ items.
audit.why: Zilean's ranged double-bomb out-pokes Rell's melee mount before her W is up, but once Crash Down + Full Tilt come online her point-and-click all-in beats a single revive and Magnet Storm lets her whole team collapse; Chronoshift plus speed re-match her lockdown once Zilean has 2+ items.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Zilean, phases[2-5].side -> Rell, phases[6].side -> Zilean, all with matching why text; phases[1].side stays Skill (already agrees with win[1]).

audit.why: Level 2 crash-range even window, Level 6 Magnet Storm collapse, first-item lockdown, and late-game revive/speed answer are already named with real abilities in spikes[] and breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Rell's Shattering Strike (Q) and Ferromancy: Crash Down (W) shields absorb burst — force them out before committing Time Bomb — and that Full Tilt's (E) auto-attack reset is the real tell to watch, not the ability cast. Neither is on the page. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed from tradeGood/tradeBad. The packet also flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Added the shield-absorb and auto-reset-tell interactions with concrete sequencing ('wait for X before Y'), gave breakdown.cooldowns real numbers, and replaced the bled bullets with matchup-specific text. Also fixed the misgendered 'his/him' references the lint flagged.
